column6: Description

Mechanic Motor Vehicle Workshop Safety focuses on avoiding injuries through PPE and proper tool use, while the **ITI MMV Trade** is a 2-year vocational course that trains students to diagnose, repair, and maintain modern automobiles.

Foundations of Workplace Safety establishes essential hazard-awareness and risk-prevention protocols for any industrial environment, which serves as the critical safety framework for the **ITI MMV Trade**—a 2-year vocational program that trains students to safely repair and maintain modern automobiles.

An instructional guide detailing the foundational importance, classifications (respiratory vs. non-respiratory), correct workshop usage, and proper maintenance of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to ensure workplace safety.

This video explains the workshop fire triangle (fuel, heat, oxygen), details how to match specific fire classes with correct extinguishers ($\text{CO}_2$/powder), and outlines emergency evacuation and daily prevention protocols.

This video outlines automotive workshop safety standards, including toxic dust ventilation, first-aid protocols (ABC rule/recovery positioning), safe vehicle lifting weight boundaries, and hazardous material disposal rules.

This video provides an automotive engineering guide to surface preparation, explaining the use of marking materials (white wash, Prussian blue), specialized cleaning brushes, emery sheets, and precision scrapers (half-round, three-square, bull-nose) to achieve accurate part fitting.

This video gives an educational introduction to structural dimensional layout, discussing flat datum reference baselines, manufacturing grades of heavy surface plates, metric tape tools, and vehicular footprint definitions (wheelbase and wheel track).

This video provides an instructional guide to workshop precision layout tools, explaining the design and exact measurement capabilities of steel rules, try squares, transfer calipers, and dividers alongside maintenance tips to prevent measurement errors.

This video provides an instructional overview of metal layout hand tools, explaining the design and applications of universal surface gauges, steel scribers, prick and center punches, cold chisels, and hollow punches.

This video explains the metallurgy, geometry, and mechanical applications of various cold chisels (flat, cross-cut, half-round, diamond-point) and engineer's hammers (ball-peen, cross-peen, straight-peen) for precision metal shaping.

This video provides an instructional overview of manual automotive hand tools, explaining the specific mechanical designs and safety practices for wooden mallets, standard and specialty screwdrivers (Phillips, offset, ratchet), and bench vices.

This video provides an instructional overview of essential workshop work-holding and fastening tools, detailing the construction and precise applications of Allen keys, bench vices, pipe vices, C-clamps, and custom toolmaker clamps alongside crucial safe operation guidelines.

This video provides an instructional overview of manual automotive hand tools, explaining the specific mechanical designs and safety practices for wooden mallets, standard and specialty screwdrivers (Phillips, offset, ratchet), and bench vices.

This video provides an instructional overview of essential workshop hand tools, detailing the mechanics and proper safety procedures for specialized spanners (ring, combination, C-spanners), socket systems, adjustable wrenches, and multi-functional pliers.

This video provides an instructional overview of various pliers types, explaining the physical designs and geometric mechanics of flat-nose, round-nose, slip-joint, multi-grip, side/end cutters, and specialty internal/external circlip and locking pliers.
This video provides an instructional overview of workshop sheet metal cutting snips, pneumatic impact/ratchet wrenches, screw extractors, and industrial high-pressure cleaning equipment.

This video explains the mechanical principles, step-by-step procedures, and safety protocols for tube flaring (single vs. double thickness) and mechanical/hydraulic parts pullers used to extract gears and bearings.

This video provides an instructional overview of the outside micrometer, explaining its mechanical construction, least count calculation ($0.01\text{ mm}$), barrel/thimble reading alignment, and essential maintenance practices.

This video provides an instructional overview of precision measurement tools, detailing the mechanical design, reading steps, and exact applications for depth micrometers ($0.01\text{ mm}$ accuracy) and universal vernier calipers ($0.02\text{ mm}$ accuracy).

This video provides an instructional overview of precision gauging and inspection instruments, explaining the mechanics and operations of telescopic gauges, dial bore gauges, dial test indicators, and structural straight edges

This video provides an instructional guide to specialized diagnostic automotive gauges, explaining the construction, proper operation, and evaluation metrics for feeler gauges, screw pitch gauges, vacuum gauges, and tire pressure gauges.

This video provides an instructional guide to drilling machines, explaining the operations of light/heavy electric drills, spark-free pneumatic drills, manual bevel-gear/breast drills, and sensitive bench drilling machines.

This video provides an instructional overview of mechanical drilling principles, explaining structural work-holding setups (T-slot clamps, parallel blocks), twist drill bit geometry (flutes and shanks), Morse taper systems, and crucial workshop safety protocols.

column5: 3 Fundamentals of Drilling, Tapping, and Threading Tools
column6: This video explains the mechanical principles and calculations for cutting internal and external screw threads using manual taps (taper, intermediate, and bottoming sets), tap wrenches, threading dies, and die stocks.

This video explains the engineering principles, structural components, step-by-step sizing calculations, and essential tool safety practices for completing high-precision manual and machine reaming operations.
This video explains the technical principles, structural tool choices, wet and dry processing methods, and safety protocols for executing high-precision surface lapping operations.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive electricity fundamentals, explaining atomic structures, free electrons, Ohm's law ($V=IR$), basic circuit loops, testing tools, and critical human safety metrics.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive electrical circuits, detailing the mechanics of series/parallel configurations, Ohm's law formulas, testing tool usage (ammeters, voltmeters, ohmmeters, multimeters), and safe diagnosis procedures.

This video provides an instructional overview of carbon composition resistors and DC series circuits, explaining resistor wattage safety, color-code multiplier tables, physical lead designs, total resistance calculation, and voltage drop properties.

This video provides an instructional guide to DC circuit analysis, detailing electromotive force (EMF) variables, series circuit voltage drop mathematics, resistor polarity mapping, and troubleshooting open circuits using a voltmeter.

This video explains the laws, reduction mathematics, ohmmeter troubleshooting, fuse protection safety, and real-world appliance wiring layouts for DC parallel and series-parallel combination circuits.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive electrical components, detailing the mechanical operations of fuses, circuit breakers, and capacitors used for overcurrent protection and temporary energy storage.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive lead-acid battery chemistry, explaining reversible electrochemical cycles, cell construction (plates and separators), hydrometer specific gravity testing, and essential storage safety.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive electrical systems, detailing electromagnetic induction, photovoltaic energy conversion, static electric charge, and diagnostic applications like relays and sensors.

This video provides an instructional overview of semiconductor theory and automotive electronics, detailing step-up ignition transformers, alternator rectification, P-N junction diode behaviors, and solid-state transistors.

This video provides an instructional overview of advanced semiconductor components, explaining NPN/PNP transistor structures, silicon controlled rectifier (SCR) operating cycles, multimeter troubleshooting, and negative temperature coefficient (NTC) thermistors.

column5: 1 Fundamentals of Pascal's Law and Hydraulic Systems
column6: This video explains the mechanical properties of fluid power based on Pascal's Law, detailing hydraulic force multiplication physics ($P=F/A$), component layouts, and automotive breaking system applications.

This video provides an instructional overview of hydraulic fluids and pumps, detailing kinematic viscosity metrics, external and internal gear pump operations, and pressure relief valve (PRV) safety rules.

This video explains the components and mechanical principles of fluid and pneumatic power systems, detailing single/double-acting cylinders, check and throttle valves, Boyle's Law, and Filter-Regulator-Lubricator (FRL) air-service units.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive classifications, detailing structural drive-train layouts (FWD/RWD/4WD), CVT transmission mechanics, industrial hydraulic hoist operations, and essential garage jack safety rules.

This video explains the principles and types of heat engines, highlighting the structural differences between internal and external combustion configurations, engine cylinder geometry, and the mechanics of a two-stroke diesel cycle.

This video outlines the structural configurations and thermodynamic operations of internal combustion engines, comparing two-stroke and four-stroke models alongside compression-ignition and spark-ignition methods.
This video outlines the engineering mechanics and thermodynamics of internal combustion engines, illustrating two-stroke and four-stroke cycle operations alongside Otto and Diesel cycle parameters.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive engine fundamentals, comparing direct vs. indirect fuel injection systems, explaining internal cylinder layouts, and breaking down engine horsepower metrics.

This video explains the mechanics and functions of internal combustion engine valves, covering popet valve angles, operating gear sequences (camshafts, pushrods, and rocker arms), hydraulic tappet clearances, and oil stems.

This video provides an instructional overview of internal combustion engine valvetrains, detailing positive valve stem oil seals, valve lead/lag timing mechanics, overlap physics, and variable valve timing (VVT) architectures.

column5: 3 Mechanics of Camshafts, Drive Systems, and Pistons
column6: This video explains the mechanical operations of automotive engines, covering camshaft profiles, piston and pushrod sequences, gear/chain/belt valvetrain drives, and variable valve timing (VVT) architectures.

This video provides an instructional overview of internal combustion engine components, detailing piston crown geometries, compression and oil control ring functions, micrometer clearance checks, and compression ratio principles.
This video explains the mechanical principles of engine connecting rods and crankshafts, detailing dropped-forged I-beam layouts, piston pin locking systems, and shell bearing metallurgy.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive bearings and clutch mechanics, detailing ball and needle roller bearing functions, dynamic balancing principles, flywheel operations, and clutch pressure plate step-by-step decoupling.

This video explains the principles and components of automotive drivetrains, covering engine cylinder block configurations, wet vs. dry liners, clutch pressure plate operations, and multi-plate vs. fluid coupling architectures.

column5: 1 Mechanic Motor Vehicle Engine Cooling Systems
column6: This video explains the mechanical engineering behind automotive engine cooling systems, comparing air and water configurations, centrifugal pumps, and bellows/wax thermostat valve controls.

column5: 2 Automotive Engine Cooling and Lubrication Systems
column6: This video details automotive thermal management and friction reduction layouts, explaining radiator core configurations, pressure cap valve regulation, antifreeze chemistries, and petrol-oil or dry-sump engine lubrication methods.

column5: 3 Automotive Engine Cooling and Lubrication systems
column6: This video explores automotive thermal and friction regulation, explaining coolant chemical additives, pressure-relief valves, positive crankcase ventilation (PCV) setups, and ECU-controlled electric cooling loops.

column5: 4 Automotive Lubrication Systems and Oil Components
column6: This video provides an instructional overview of automotive lubrication systems, explaining oil pump plumbing mechanics, full-flow versus bypass filtration, oil viscosity science, and SAE oil grades for varying temperatures.

This video explains the mechanics of automotive induction and exhaust systems, detailing turbocharging/supercharging configurations, air compressors, exhauster vacuums, and intercooler dense-air thermal cooling.

column5: 2 Automotive Intake and Exhaust Systems Engineering
column6: This video explains the mechanics of automotive intake and exhaust systems, detailing exhaust backpressure parameters, fixed vs. variable geometry turbochargers, reverse-flow mufflers, and catalytic converter emission controls.

column5: 1 Diesel Fuel Systems and Quiet Engine Technology
column6: This video explains the mechanics of diesel fuel injection systems, detailing compression-ignition parameters, cetane rating factors, electronic pilot injection noise-reduction setups, and fuel tank baffle plumbing architectures.

column5: 2 Fundamentals of Fuel Filtration and Feed Pump Systems
column6: This video provides an instructional overview of diesel fuel conditioning, explaining moisture condensation hazards, two-stage filtration mechanics, line bleeding procedures to clear air locks, and mechanical feed-pump plunger operations.

This video details the engineering behind automotive diesel fuel injection pumps, comparing inline and distributor pump designs, helical groove plunger operations, mechanical/pneumatic governors, and modern Electronic Diesel Control (EDC) loops.

This video explains the principles of Electronic Diesel Control (EDC), describing how the Electronic Control Module (ECM) processes analog sensor data into precise digital actuator outputs to govern fuel injection and engine timing.

This video explains the mechanics of Common Rail Direct Injection (CRDI) systems, describing how an Electronic Control Module (ECM) regulates high-pressure fuel pumps up to 2000 bar via specialized sensors and actuators.

This video details specialized automotive engine assembly and diagnostic techniques, covering micrometric measurement tools, piston ring compression procedures, and structural non-destructive testing for cracks.

This video provides an instructional overview of automotive pollutants and emission standards, covering evaporative vs. exhaust emissions, public health impacts, and the evolution of European and Bharat Stage (BS) regulation frameworks.

This video details the mechanical and chemical operations of an Evaporative Emission Control (EVAP) system, illustrating how charcoal canisters trap hydrocarbon fumes and how internal combustion generates greenhouse gases and NOx emissions.

This video details the mechanical and chemical operations of a Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF), explaining combustion chamber design, incomplete fuel burning, wall-flow ceramic trapping, and active versus passive DPF regeneration methods.

This video explains the mechanics of Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) and Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems, describing how they regulate internal engine temperatures and decompose toxic NOx emissions into safe components.

This video details the mechanical and electrical principles of automotive alternators, covering claw-pole rotor and stator configurations, diode rectifier AC-to-DC conversion, and electronic voltage regulation.

This video details automotive electrical evolution and troubleshooting, contrasting heavy DC generators with modern efficient alternators while charting diagnostics for no-charge, overcharging, and bearing noises.

This video explains the mechanics of automotive starting systems, describing how battery electrical currents actuate solonoid plungers and trigger high-torque series-wound DC motors to spin engine flywheels up to 100 RPM.

This video outlines a methodical framework for automotive troubleshooting, detailing diagnostic sequences for starting failures, drop in engine power, overheating parameters, and mechanical sound indicators.
